notes: Runtime captures (xcrun simctl io screenshot) of a Debug build on the persistent iPhone Duo (closed), on the Sample board's built-in sample data. The Sample board screens open through its saved mode, as on a relaunch, via the launch argument -sampleBoard.v1 YES (and -ScreenshotTab for the tab); Connect used -sampleBoard.v1 NO. Avatars are local identicons left in the simulator's App Group cache by earlier fixture runs; nothing is fetched over the network. Review fixes (connect-over-sample-board.png, people-initials.png): captured at the later sourceCommit; the Sample board no longer reads the App Group avatar cache, so its people show initials. connect-over-sample-board.png used the Debug launch argument -ScreenshotConnect (starts Connect GitHub as a tap would); its code is a real, unapproved GitHub device code that expired unused.
